posts.author: Pehriska
posts.body:
Hello again.
I've been working on a 2d point and click adventure game made in MV which has just released!
Available on Itch -
https://pehriska.itch.io/penance
Game
- Penance
Story
- Set in medieval England you play as the son of Sir William Marshal who returns to his brother's castle to find the realm in a precarious state.
About the Game
- 2D side-scroller.
- Gameplay is classic point and click adventure game.
- Historical setting and characters
- Inventory, quests and glossary in the Items section.
- Can be played with keyboard, mouse or controller.
- 30-60 minutes of gameplay
- Made with the help of SideMV's template.
Thanks for stopping by!
